decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the requested lighting around the bowls.
Silver render-inspired controls are a detail of the control-styling Requirement and do not alter the candidate's existing premium DJ-style identity.
The client expresses interest in exploring a K on the buttons, but does not confirm a button-branding design; propagation would require resolving that open design choice.
The silver finish applies specifically to buttons and knobs and can coexist with the established beige-and-green machine scheme; no current candidate key is contradicted or made obsolete.
The source changes control styling and does not change bowl capacity or bowl form.
References to the renderings concern controls and visual details, not the spout's construction, geometry, orientation, or pouring behavior.
The source contains no change to splash prevention or high-speed mixing behavior.
The aesthetic preference for silver controls does not necessarily revise the approved component set or BOM deliverable.
The source does not change service access, removable panels, fluid routing, or maintenance operations.
Although the selected styling may inform later design work, the source does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
Control appearance and finish do not alter the required mixing texture, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The conditional visual preferences for a possible rebuilt base do not necessarily change the existing off-the-shelf sourcing policy or its established custom-fabrication exceptions.
